name: [CONTENT UPDATE | VR] Ro!Qube 🎵
desc:
[ WARNING: This game contains flashing lights that can affect photosensitive players. Please use caution when playing. ]

Ro!Qube is a 2-in-1 rhythm game with a classic VSRG 4K Mania mode and a note-slicing VR mode.
Join our group to receive 5% more XP per play! Premium players also receive 25% more XP per play.

Ro!Qube officially supports Meta Quest, Valve Index, and PSVR2. Other headsets may not work or require extra configuration to run correctly.

Need help? Have a map in the game and you want it removed? Join our Community Server below!

⚠️ Exploiting (such as using an auto-player) is NOT ALLOWED. You will be permanently banned if caught. ⚠️
